title: UIL Academic and Robotics Team Participation Packet and the 2026-27 Participation Fee, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
**Online activities registration — UIL Academic and Robotics Team.** For a UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the participation fee posts on the date the parent or guardian submits the signed participation packet, at the amount the 2026-27 UIL Academic and Robotics fee schedule sets.

**The packet is the family's own submission.** The parent or guardian signs and submits the parent permission, code of conduct and overnight travel permission forms through the district's online activities registration, and the submission records the three forms and posts the participation fee.

| What the submission does | Business effect seen by the family |
|---|---|
| records the three signed forms | each form shows as received, dated the day of submission |
| posts the participation fee | a new participation fee entry dated that day; the household's amount due on the participation rises by the fee |

## Invocation: `submit_uil_packet_8c6962d4`

This is the family's own tool. The agent unlocks `submit_uil_packet_8c6962d4` and hands it over; the customer themselves (the parent or guardian) runs it to submit the signed packet. The agent does not submit the packet for the family.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `activity_participation_id` | reference number of the student's UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation, as returned by the activity participation lookup | identifier |
| `participation_fee_amount` | the participation fee to post, in US dollars | a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent (half a cent rounds up); any further digits are rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** On success, a record of the submission: `activity_participation_id`; `forms_recorded`, the list of the three form codes recorded; `fee_ledger_id`, the reference number of the new participation fee entry; `participation_fee_amount`, in US dollars with 2 decimal places; `submitted_date`, today, as YYYY-MM-DD; and `status` reading "submitted".

**Error.** A malformed amount (not a positive amount in US dollars) returns a `status` of "error" with a message, and nothing is recorded.
